intent: Implement contextual route-specific 'Take Tour' onboarding feature with header ? trigger, localStorage memory for new users, and interactive step-by-step feature walkthrough.
summary: Implemented the interactive 'Take Tour' contextual onboarding subsystem (PSI-111). CODE: (1) Route tour configuration in src/features/tour/config/routes-tour.ts: unique multi-step tours configured for /dashboard/overview (AI digest, KPIs, charts), /dashboard/finance (ledger, add entry, category trends, AI tools), /dashboard/kanban & /dashboard/boards (multi-board tabs, drag-and-drop, task detail dialog), /dashboard/calendar (Google 2-way sync, agenda, event-to-board streamline), /dashboard/ai-chat (grounded tools, prompt starters, multi-model inference), /dashboard/documents (Drive sync, RBAC scoping), /dashboard/talent (pipeline, CV upload, skill taxonomy), and /dashboard/settings (connected apps, OAuth revocation), plus default fallback. (2) State & Onboarding provider src/features/tour/context/tour-context.tsx: manages tour state, step navigation, and localStorage persistence (p3md_tour_seen_<route>), auto-prompting first-time visitors per route after gentle 1.2s delay. (3) TourModal UI src/features/tour/components/tour-modal.tsx: accessible spotlight modal with progress bar, step badges, rich descriptions, actionable tips, interactive dot indicators, keyboard arrow controls, and 'Don't auto-show again' toggle. (4) Header ? trigger src/features/tour/components/tour-trigger.tsx: Help popover integrated into global Header next to NotificationCenter with pulsing unread dot for unseen tours and 'Take Tour' / 'Reset all tours' actions. (5) Integrated globally via Providers and Header. (6) Unit tests: 3 comprehensive tests in src/features/tour/__tests__/tour.test.ts (123 frontend tests passing, 22 edge function tests passing, typecheck clean, lint clean).
